transcript_schema._description: transcript.jsonl line schema, verified hands-on 2026-08-11 (agy 1.1.11, headless; one run with run_command tool call).

fields.note: tool entries use the SCREAMING_SNAKE tool name; 9 further values (ASK_QUESTION, CODE_ACTION, EPHEMERAL_MESSAGE, GENERIC, INVOKE_SUBAGENT, MCP_TOOL, READ_URL_CONTENT, SEARCH_WEB, SYSTEM_MESSAGE) promoted by transcript audit 2026-08-11 (49,586 lines / 33 sessions); per-value source citations in audits/transcript-audit-2026-08-10.json
in-progress steps use RUNNING (408x observed); failed steps use ERROR (108x) — verified by audit 2026-08-11; earlier 'ACTIVE expected' guess superseded

fields.description: USER_INPUT: prompt wrapped in <USER_REQUEST>/<ADDITIONAL_METADATA>/<USER_SETTINGS_CHANGE>; PLANNER_RESPONSE: model reply; RUN_COMMAND: command output; CHECKPOINT: truncation summary with {{ CHECKPOINT N }} marker
Tools invoked on PLANNER_RESPONSE; each {name, args}; run_command args include CommandLine, Cwd, WaitMsBeforeAsync, toolAction, toolSummary

notes: created_at field is UTC; tool-output content headers (Created At/Completed At) use local time with offset
conversation_id is not stored in the file; derive from the directory name
transcript_full.jsonl stores tool-call args as native JSON; transcript.jsonl stores them escaped
step_index is not necessarily contiguous — one PLANNER_RESPONSE may issue multiple tool_calls
tool args carry metadata fields toolAction and toolSummary alongside tool-specific args (AbsolutePath, DirectoryPath, CommandLine/Cwd/WaitMsBeforeAsync)
ERROR_MESSAGE entries (source SYSTEM) embed failure text with Guidance and Retries remaining: N; no exit_code
LIST_DIRECTORY output is JSON-lines: {name, sizeBytes} per entry
checkpoint entries embed absolute paths to the log files
headless probe: RUN_COMMAND Cwd was the CLI config dir, not the invocation dir; an interactive run used the correct workspace cwd
